about.title: About Dhanori Yellow Pages
about.introParagraph: Dhanori Yellow Pages is a free, community-driven directory of local businesses and services in Dhanori, Pune. Our goal is simple: make it easy for residents to find trusted, verified businesses in their neighbourhood — from plumbers and electricians to doctors and grocery stores.
about.whyParagraph: Finding reliable local services in a growing area like Dhanori can be frustrating. Google Maps listings are often outdated, phone numbers change, and new businesses pop up faster than any map can track. We wanted a directory that is maintained by and for the community — where anyone can suggest a business, leave a review, and flag incorrect information.
about.howSearch: Search & browse — Find businesses by name, service, category, or area. Filter by open now, verified, or emergency availability.
about.howVerified: Verified listings — Our team verifies business details by calling them directly. Look for the verified badge.
about.howReviews: Community reviews — Rate and review businesses you've used. All reviews are moderated before publishing.
about.howEmergency: Emergency contacts — Quick access to police, fire, ambulance, and other emergency helplines — always one tap away.

about.coverageParagraph: We cover Dhanori and its surrounding sub-localities including Dhanori Gaon, Vishrantwadi, Lohegaon, Dhanori Phata, Kalas, and more. If your business serves the Dhanori area, it belongs here.
